name: full-auto
description: Unattended pipeline: explore -> plan -> oracle review -> planner revision -> worker implements -> 3 reviewers -> oracle triage -> worker fixes

parallel.label: Split into areas
parallel.task:
Analyze this request and split it into the distinct areas worth exploring before planning: {task}

Return the areas via structured_output as {"items":[{"area":"kebab-slug","focus":"what to investigate"}]}. Keep it to the areas that materially affect the plan. Do not edit files.

parallel.label: External research (if needed)
parallel.task:
Decide whether this request needs external research: {task}

It needs external research only when it depends on facts outside the local codebase: unfamiliar libraries or APIs, framework versions or migrations, official specs, benchmarks, or recent upstream changes. If it is purely internal codebase work, return exactly one line: 'No external research needed.' and stop. Otherwise run a tight research budget (broad targeted searches, fetch only the strongest sources, stop when required facts are covered) and return a concise brief with source links, confidence, and the implications for the plan.

parallel.label: Explore {target.area}

chain.label: Draft plan
Review plan
Revise plan
Implement plan

parallel.label: Correctness
parallel.task:
Review the changes just implemented for correctness and regressions: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: bugs, broken edge cases, missing validation, failing paths. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

parallel.label: Readability
parallel.task:
Review the changes just implemented for readability: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: unclear names, confusing control flow, dead code, noise comments. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

parallel.label: Maintainability
parallel.task:
Review the changes just implemented for maintainability: {task}

Inspect the actual diff and code. Report only evidence-backed findings with file/line references: duplication, coupling, missing tests for changed behavior, hard-to-change structure. Do not modify project/source files; returning findings through the configured output artifact is allowed.

chain.label: Triage fixes
Apply fixes
